description: This PHP class defines the Coupon model for the OpenCart admin report extension, providing methods to retrieve coupon data and totals with optional filtering by date range.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Model class for accessing coupon report data, including retrieving coupon details and total counts.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of coupons with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total number of coupons matching the optional filters.
